Right-wing politics , or rightism , is the range of political ideologies that view certain social stratifications and orders as inevitable, natural, normal, or desirable, [ 1 ] [ 2 ] [ 3 ] typically supporting this position in favour of conservatism , natural law , economics , authority , property , religion , or tradition . [ 4 ] [ 5 ] [ 6 ] [ 7 ] [ 8 ] [ 9 ] [ 10 ] Hierarchy and inequality may be seen as natural results of traditional social differences [ 11 ] [ 12 ] or competition in market economies . [ 13 ] [ 14 ] [ 15 ]
